x.instructions: For x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation. Select positive for increase, negative for decrease, hold for within_tolerance. This corrects only the authorized high pose; do not infer clearance or possession.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
criteria.hold: Apply no correction within its supplied tolerance.
criteria.positive: Increase this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.

gripper.instructions: Read state.processed_features.objective.gripper. This slice requires keep; preserve the existing open command without initiating closure or reopening.

criteria.open: Only deliver an explicitly supplied open objective.
criteria.close: Only deliver an explicitly supplied close objective.
criteria.keep: Preserve the existing gripper command as required.
